Technical SEO.title: Google AI Overview Links Pushing You To AI Mode Over Web Pages
Technical SEO.summary: Google is inserting links within AI Overviews that route users into AI Mode rather than to external web pages, with the links appearing at the bottom of the Overview and triggering follow-up questions. This represents a structural shift in how AI Overview traffic flows away from publisher sites.

Technical SEO.title: Google Page Experience Docs Adds CrUX Ad Metrics
Technical SEO.summary: Google updated its page experience documentation to include new CrUX ad metrics, adding them to the Page Experience Resources section, though Google has not stated these metrics are a ranking signal for search.

Technical SEO.title: Google Merchant Center Auto Enables Native Checkout: Buy On AI Mode and Gemini
Technical SEO.summary: Google is notifying Merchant Center users that products on platforms supporting Universal Commerce Protocol are now automatically eligible for native checkout directly on Google, including via AI Mode and Gemini. Merchants who want users to complete purchases on their own site must actively opt out.

Technical SEO.title: Gemini Notebook Pages Spamming Google Search
Technical SEO.summary: Spammers are exploiting public NotebookLM pages within Gemini Notebook to publish spam content across categories including coupons and adult content that is indexable in Google Search. This signals an emerging spam vector tied to Google's own AI tooling that could affect search quality.

Technical SEO.title: Google Analytics Adds Include Filters For Hostnames
Technical SEO.summary: Google Analytics now supports Include data filters for hostnames, allowing properties to retain event data only from approved domains rather than having to exclude spam sources individually. This is a meaningful quality-of-life improvement for enterprise teams managing data integrity across large property sets.

Digital Marketing / Martech.title: Which Data Sources Should You Care About For AI Search?
Digital Marketing / Martech.summary: The article offers a tiered framework for identifying which data sources AI search engines pull from, helping SEOs prioritize where to focus GEO efforts. It addresses the fact that AI search draws from more sources than most practitioners currently track.

Digital Marketing / Martech.title: GEO Requests Rise Among More Search Freelancers Than Google SEO
Digital Marketing / Martech.summary: A Fiverr survey found that more of its search freelancers are reporting rising demand for GEO work than for traditional Google-ranking work, though the majority still expect SEO to remain important long term. This signals a notable market shift in how search optimization services are being procured.

Digital Marketing / Martech.title: 3 Steps To Win B2B Brand Consideration, Day Zero Decides The Shortlist
Digital Marketing / Martech.summary: The piece argues that B2B buying groups arrive with vendor shortlists already formed, meaning answer engine optimization alone cannot compensate for brand visibility gaps created months before active research begins. It outlines three steps for building brand consideration before the research phase starts.

AI Search / GEO.title: Techmagnate Study Finds AI Platforms Drop 39% of Cited Brands Every Week, Signals Shift in How AI Visibility Should Be Measured
AI Search / GEO.summary: A Techmagnate study found that AI platforms cycle out 39% of the brands they cite on a weekly basis, suggesting that brand visibility in AI-generated answers is highly volatile and requires continuous monitoring rather than point-in-time measurement.

AI Search / GEO.title: Generative Engine Optimization Emerges as the Holiday Season's Fastest-Growing Service
AI Search / GEO.summary: A press release reports that GEO has emerged as the fastest-growing service category heading into the holiday season, reflecting accelerating enterprise and retail demand for AI search visibility optimization.

AI Search / GEO.title: Show HN: Training a model to identify AI web content from structure alone
AI Search / GEO.summary: A research project presented on Hacker News demonstrates training a model to detect AI-generated web content based on structural patterns alone, without relying on linguistic cues. The approach has implications for how AI search engines may differentiate or filter AI-produced content at scale.

AI Search / GEO.title: LLM Citation Study: 13,184 Citations Across 4 AI Tools
AI Search / GEO.summary: Orbit Media Studios analyzed 13,184 citations across four major AI tools to identify citation patterns and source preferences in AI-generated answers. The study offers a data-driven foundation for understanding which content types and domains earn references in AI search responses.
